translations.web: I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
translations.bsb: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.
translations.kjv: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
translations.asv: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was waste and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
